Commentary.Commentary: Winning can do wonders to a team's morale. West Indies will be on cloud nine at the moment and will head to Lord's with the hope of claiming the series. England, on the other hand, will have to quickly regroup after this embarrassing loss. The last Test match starts on 7th September. Do join us at 1000 GMT (1100 local) for all the action. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Shai Hope says he feels great after this performance. Further adds they are working very hard as a team. Admits he always believes in himself no matter what he is doing. Mentions they did fancy themselves at the start of the day. Credits Jermaine Blackwood for the way he played and says he took a lot of pressure off him.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that he believes in his group and they have done outstanding things in the recent past. Adds that he just told his boys to believe in themselves. Terms the chase nerve-racking. Credits Shai Hope for his knock and also has a word of praise for Kraigg Brathwaite. He is happy that they delivered on big stage. Thanks all the fans who have stuck around with them even after disappointing results. Admits that they still need to be a lot more consistent with the ball and emphasizes on the fact that they have to work on their catching. A special mention by him for their bowling coach who lost his mother a few days back.

England skipper, Joe Root says that it was a great Test match for everybody watching and he is happy to be a part of it. Credits Shai Hope for his innings against a high quality bowling line-up. Adds they know the Windies are a talented side and they never got complacent. Appreciates the fight and the determination showed by his team. Mentions it is always good to look back and think that things could have been done differently. Feels the dropped catches probably cost them the Test match. Acknowledges Dawid Malan and Mark Stoneman for their innings and is happy with the way they approached their batting. Ends by saying, he has no regrets about the decision to declare and if there is an opportunity to win the Test match they would want to take it.

Cricket is a funny old game. You can never count any team out. Credit to West Indies for sticking around after a heavy defeat in the first Test match and in spite of all the criticism, they never lost focus. England will be shell-shocked at the moment. But they will admit that they are beaten by the better team. It was a great Test match and the declaration from Joe Root yesterday spiced it up. He could have easily batted on and on but instead decided to put the Windies in and force a result. However, his bowlers were not penetrative enough and the dropped catches didn't help their cause either.

The home side batted better in their second innings and on day 4 managed to declare after achieving a 321-run lead. We all thought that it will be a big achievement for the Windies if they manage to draw this game but the tourists had other plans. Once again Kraigg Brathwaite and Shai Hope raised a century stand to keep the chase on track. Shai carried on after losing his partner and batted through, thereby registering his second century in the match, a record at this venue.

Tremendous victory for West Indies to level the series! They were written off before this match after receiving a hammering at Edgbaston but they turned it around here. Great bowling by Shannon Gabriel and Kemar Roach restricted England to a low first innings total and then, powered by the centuries from Kraigg Brathwaite and Shai Hope, they managed to gain a 169-run lead.

WEST INDIES WIN BY 5 WICKETS! Their first in England in 17 years! Back of a length delivery on middle, Shai Hope jumps inside the crease and glances it off his pads through backward square leg to collect a couple of runs. Hope screams in joy, the West Indian players are absolutely delighted in the dressing room. What a win for them! Totally against everyone's expectations.
Fuller and on off, driven on the up to mid off.
Shane Dowrich is the next man in. He is on a king pair.

OUT! Stumped! Rush of blood and Blackwood loses his cool. He dances down the track looking for the glory shot but it spins back in sharply with extra bounce to beat his bat. Bairstow does the rest. The end of Jermaine. He is not looking too happy but has done his job. 2 more needed for a win.
Floated ball on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Off goes the helmet. He is setting himself for a big shot, it seems.
On the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Dropped by Stokes! They are not interested now, it appears. A flighted off spinner, Blackwood swings it over mid-wicket but fails to clear the fence. Stokes in the deep puts down a sitter and that very much sums up England's performance. A single taken.
Back of a length ball on off, Hope camps back and punches it down to mid off.
Angling into the batsman, on a length, the batsman keeps it out off the inside half of the bat to square leg and steals a single.
A touch short and on off, Hope goes on his toes and glances it through square leg for a run.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Wide! Wild delivery, way wide outside off, Blackwood leaves it alone.
Play and a miss! A touch short in length on off, Jermaine tries to pull it across the line but misses. Nearly got an inside edge there.
Short and wide outside off, Blackwood hops back to make space and then allows it through to the keeper.
Chris Woakes replaces Stuart Broad. 10 runs more needed.
An off spinner on off, Hope lunges and defends it watchfully.
Flatter and on off, Hope gets a bit squared up and it goes off the outer half of the bat to point.
Fires in a full ball on middle, it's kept out towards the bowler.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then helps it to square leg.
Loopy off spinner on off, Hope gets across the stumps and blocks it with a straight bat.
Tossed up ball on off, Hope leans forward to defend but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man. A brace taken.
Very full and outside off, driven straight to short cover. 12 needed more!

SIX! Up and over Moeen! Short in length and outside off, Jermaine goes on his toes and upper cuts it over the jumping third man fielder for a biggie. For some reason, Moeen was not at the edge of the boundary. Could have been a different result, had he been there.
Straighter delivery, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

Given as a dead ball! Broad spears a full ball down the leg side, Blackwood tries hitting across the line but fails to connect. He falls in the process and the ball races off his pads to the fine leg fence. Not given as a boundary. Strange call. The batsman was definitely trying to play a shot, there.

FOUR! Full marks to the intent. Almost identical to the last delivery. The bowler follows the batsman again but this time Blackwood makes room and tries to hit it through the line. It flies off the outside edge and runs away to the third man fence.
Follows the batsman down the leg side with a shortish ball, Blackwood is cramped for room and ends up playing it back.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
50-run stand between Shai Hope and Jermaine Blackwood. They have brought the Windies very close, they only need 24 now.
Four byes! Big spin down the leg side, the batsman fails to flick and the keeper also fails to collect. It happily runs down to the fine leg fence.
Curling back into the batsman from around off, Hope defends it to the leg side.
Flighted off spinner on middle, once again staying low, Shai plays it off his pads to the leg side.
Long hop on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Turning back into the batsman from around off, staying low too, Hope keeps his eyes on the ball and keeps it out behind square leg for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Shai taps it down to covers and scampers across to the other end.
Fractionally short and around off, Hope tries working on the leg side but it stops a shade on him and he ends up pushing it out off the toe end. It pops out but doesn't carry to the bowler.
Fast and furious bouncer by Broad. Well-directed at the batsman. Shai Hope hurries down and lets it go over his head. Loses his balance too in the process.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Blackwood turns it off his hips to deep backward square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, it's driven confidently through covers for a single.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, it's left alone by Hope.
A touch short and spinning back in, Blackwood punches it to mid on. 33 more needed for a win!
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tries working around the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Not out! Loopy ball outside off, Hope strides forward with a big stretch and tries to drive through the line. He misses and the keeper takes the bails off quickly. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The replays show that Hope is safely in.
There is referral for a stumping against Shai Hope. Jonny Bairstow looks confident here.
Tossed up on middle, worked from the pads to mid-wicket.
In the air... safe! Flighted ball outside off, Blackwood has a big swipe at it but gets a top edge down to deep point. A single taken.
Moeen Ali is into the attack now.
Full and angling down the leg side, Blackwood flicks it  in the air and it goes safely to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length ball on middle, Hope pulls it to mid-wicket for a single and straightaway says no for the second run.
Once again some width on offer for the batsman, Hope swings and misses.

DROPPED BY COOK! Not going England's way! A little bit of width on offer outside off, Shai goes hard at it and tries to power it through the line. But it takes a thick outside edge and goes like a tracer bullet to Cook at first slip. He reacts but fails to hang on to the catch. Broad cannot believe his luck.
Edgy! Broad lands it on a length outside off, Jermaine gives himself room and flashes his bat through the line. It takes the toe end and flies down to third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, not much room to work with and Blackwood hits it straight back towards the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, straightening a touch, Shai goes back and punches it straight to covers. 38 more needed!
Angles in a full ball on off, Shai lunges and defends it close to his front pad.
Repeats the last delivery, this time from the middle stump line. Hope closes the face of the bat and eases it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Serves it on a driving length outside off, nipping away, Shai watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Boom! Width on offer outside off, Hope latches onto the room and drills it through covers for a cracking boundary.
A gentle length delivery outside off, Shai allows it through to the keeper.
Short in length and on off, not much room to work with. Blackwood leans back and taps it down to point. 44 more needed!
Outside off, Blackwood pushes inside the line and misses.
Back of a length ball on middle, hit across the line through mid-wicket for a single.
2nd Test hundred for Shai Hope.

Hundred for Shai Hope! Take a bow, lad. He has etched his name in the record books. First batsman to get a twin century at this venue. Records apart, talk about his knock under pressure today. Tremendous. Full length ball on off, angling in, Shai tries to whip it across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It ricochets to the off side and they cross for a single. Huge ovation from the crowd. The West Indian players are on their feet in the balcony. What a moment for the young man! But he will know, the job is not done yet.
Good leave! On a length and just outside off, holding its line, Hope shoulders arms.
Fuller length ball angling into the batsman on middle, Shai brings down a straight bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Stuart Broad will share the second new ball.
Drinks. The Test match heads into the last hour. 47 more needed. A nervy end on the cards.
Full and wide outside off, Blackwood goes for it but does not make contact.
Fuller in length on middle, Hope drives it towards mid on who dives to his left and saves three.

In the air... but safe! Fuller this time on off, Blackwood tries to hit it over long off but mistimes it and it goes on the bounce for a run. He was lucky he did not hit that any better or would have gone straight to the fielder there.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

SIX! BANG! Blackwood wants to finish it early. Absolutely no respect given to Anderson there. James comes running in and bowls it on a length on middle. Blackwood moves his front leg across and lofts it straight back over the bowler's head. They go upstairs to check whether it has crossed the ropes and yes it has. A maximum signalled by the umpire.
That was timed beautifully! Anderson angles it on the pads, Hope flicks it through square leg for a run.
Taken straightaway by England. James Anderson returns to operate first up with the second new cherry. This is the last throw of the dice from the hosts.

FOUR! Woakes serves it on a fuller length around off, Blackwood gives it the full swing of his bat and powers it down to cow corner for a boundary. Second new ball is due now. Is it going to be taken?
Good shot off the back foot by Hope. He stands tall and punches it through covers for a single.
Straighter in line, it's worked away through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Slants one in around off, it's defended back with a straight bat by Blackwood.
Full and offering width outside off, Hope cracks it through covers and takes a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Hope gets behind the line and defends it watchfully.
Tucks it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Drives it with the spin down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Blackwood punches it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up outside off, Hope drives it through covers for a run.

NOT OUT! It was nothing but a tactical review by England, as the reviews will be refreshed after the 80th over. Ali floats it outside off, turning back in sharply. Hope tries to defend but gets beaten and is struck on the pads. The English players appeal but nothing from the umpire. They opt to review it. Replays show the impact was umpire's call and the ball was just clipping the leg stump. The on-field call stays. England have lost both their reviews now. Also a message has come out from the West Indian dressing room.
A tactical review by England for an LBW against Hope. A little too high it seems.
Flighted ball outside off, Hope drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Blackwood is losing the plot here! Just back of a length outside off, stays low. JB swings at it but does not connect.
PEACH! Fuller in length on off, swinging away. JB tries to work it on the leg side but gets beaten.
Fuller outside off, Blackwood tries to go big but gets beaten. There is a muted appeal from the Englishmen but the umpire stays put.
Blackwood is going for it here! Comes down the track to Woakes. Chris bangs it short. Blackwood mistimes it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length outside off, Hope punches it through the off side for a run.

CONFUSION BUT SAFE! Floats it on off, turning back in. Blackwood drives it towards mid on and sets off for a run but is sent back by Hope. Anderson stationed there, is quick to the ball and fires a throw to the keeper but Blackwood makes his ground.

FOUR! This is the way Blackwood plays. There was a man in the deep but it makes no difference to him. Ali tosses it up around off, Blackwood heaves it in the gap between deep mid-wicket and long on for a boundary.
Works it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Blackwood punches it down the ground for a run.
Floats it outside off, Hope slashes at it and gets it behind square on the off side. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and saves a run for his team.
Flatter outside off, skids off the surface. Hope tries to defend it but gets a bottom edge on the bounce to first slip.
Moeen Ali to have another go.
Wide outside off, JB opts not to play at it. A wicket maiden for England, just what the doctor ordered.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Back of a length on off, Blackwood punches it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Blackwood lets it be.
Shorter and outside off, Blackwood goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Jermaine Blackwood is the next man in.

OUT! Now then, what has Chase done there? He has just thrown it away. The bowling change has done the trick for England. Woakes comes running in and bowls it on a length around off, Chase shuffles across and tries to go over mid on but mistimes it. Mason Crane, the substitute, stationed there runs across to his left and stretches to take a brilliant catch. Woakes who has had a poor time with the ball has provided the breakthrough. West Indies need 76 runs more.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Fuller in length outside off, Chase square drives it towards point. Stokes stationed there dives to his right and keeps it down to a single.
Good length on off, Chase defends it watchfully.
Shortish length delivery around off, Chase tries to cut but ends up chopping it to the left of Anderson.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter in length around off, Chase guides it to point.
Short delivery, Hope ducks underneath it comfortably.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.

FIVE RUNS! This is sloppy now from England. They are feeling the pressure. Broad lands it on a length around off. Chase plays it towards point and sets off for a run. Stokes gets to the ball and fires a needless wild throw towards the striker's end. The man who was backing up is unable to stop it. Also the man in the deep runs to his left and dives but in vain as the ball crosses the rope. 77 runs more needed now.
Fuller in length on off, Chase drives it to mid off.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller in length on off, Chase plays it towards point.

Just short this time! Lands it on a length around off. Chase pokes at it and gets an outside edge which falls just short of Root. He dives to his right and makes a half stop. He saves three runs for his team. Anderson is bowling with no luck here.

EDGY FOUR! Just the slice of luck the Windies need. A length on off, shapes away a touch. Chase tries to defend but gets an outside edge which goes between first slip and the keeper for a boundary. Anderson can't believe it. The keeper was a bit flat-footed there, failed to react in time, also Root didn't anticipate it.
Bowls it on leg stump, Chase tucks it to mid-wicket.
Lands it on the perfect length around off. Chase defends it solidly.
Shorter outside off, Chase guides it to point.
Lands it on a length on off, Chase defends it with ease.
Drifts it on the pads, Chase nudges it down to fine leg for a run.

Almost drags it on! Shorter this time on middle, gets big on Chase. He swivels inside the crease and goes for the pull but the ball hits him on the gloves. It bounces just in front of the stumps and rolls towards the off side.
Angles it on the pads, Hope tucks it around the corner for a run.
Full ball on off, Hope cracks it straight to the man at covers. He was not happy with himself there. He thought he should have put that away.

A delay here as Broad is having issues with his run-up. The area behind the wickets from where the bowler usually takes off in his delivery stride is a bit slippery. The groundsmen are out with the hammer and trying to make it better.
Fullish on off, Hope drives it to covers.
Fuller in length on off, Chase drops it in front of covers for a run.
FOUR! Anderson bowls it around middle, extra bounce again, Hope fends at it and gets it away off the inside edge to fine leg. 90 more needed.

How has that missed the off pole? Brilliant from Anderson. Fuller in length, shaping back in from around off. Hope goes for the drive but is beaten by the inswing and the ball goes between bat and pad to the keeper.
FOUR! That was cut hard! Shorter outside off, just a little bit of width there. Hope slashes at it and gets it through backward point for a boundary.
Good length on off, Hope defends it with ease.
Shorter on off, Shai pushes it to covers.

Comes running in and lands it on a length. The ball bounces a little more than expected and hits Hope high on his bat as he tries to defend. We have seen quite a few deliveries like these but the batsmen have played it well.
Angles it into the pads, Hope flicks it through the leg side for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it on a length on off, spits off the surface. Hope does well to defend it.

NOT OUT! Yes, it is missing leg! A bad review by England. Broad angles it on the pads. Hope fails to flick it and the ball brushes the pads. The English players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Broad wants it to be reviewed and Root does so. The replays show that it was going down. The on-field call stays and England lose a review. The ball also goes down to the fine leg fence for FOUR LEG BYES. The Windies need 99 now.
England have taken a review for LBW against Hope. That looks like it's missing leg.
Excellent fielding from the skipper Root. He is leading from the front here. A touch fuller outside off, Hope tries to run it down towards third man but Root at slip dives to his right and stops it.
Just behind a length on off, Hope tries to work it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bowls it on a length, pitches on off and comes into the batsman. Chase does well to block it.
Good length on middle, Chase defends it to silly mid on.
Inswinger on off, Chase defends it watchfully.
Again! Bowls it on a length on middle, Chase defends it solidly.
Shorter in length outside off, Chase tries to force it through the off side but gets it off the inner half to silly mid on.
Fuller in length on off, Chase presses forward and blocks it.
Fires it wide outside off, Hope goes for the drive but nails it on the bounce, straight to the man at point.
Fullish and on off, Hope drives it off his front foot to covers.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on off. Hope defends it to point.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Shai drives it to mid off.
He comes steaming in and lands it on a length outside off. Hope lets it be.
Back of a length on the stumps. Hope tucks it to mid-wicket. The crowd is right behind Broad.
Stuart Broad is into the attack.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Chase camps back and defends it with a straight bat.
Anderson comes running in and bowls it on a length around off. Chase defends it solidly.
Lands it on a length around off, Chase defends it towards cover.
The away swinger this time. Pitches it on off and gets it to move away slightly. Chase gets squared up as he tries to defend but does well to keep it out.
Just ahead of a length on off, nipping back. Chase defends it towards mid-wicket.
Good length on off, bounces a little more than expected. Chase does well to keep that out.
BEATEN! Fires it on off, straightens a touch. Hope plays for the spin but gets beaten.
Very full outside off, Chase square drives it on the off side for a run.
Flatter on middle, Hope goes back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. Good from the Windies, they are keeping the scoreboard ticking.
Drives it down to long on with the spin for a run.
Slower through the air on the fuller side outside off, Roston drives it through extra cover for a brace.
Tosses it up on off, Chase drives it back to the bowler.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it.
Shorter in length but does not bounce that high. Chase tucks it off his hips towards mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length on off, Chase defends it towards covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
LOVELY! These are perfect conditions to bowl seam. Anderson lands it on a length around off, seams away after pitching. Chase is beaten as he tries to defend it.
Almost! A length ball on off, jags back in late. Hope does well to flick it down to deep square leg for a run.
Flighted on off, Chase presses forward and defends it towards the off side. He sets off for a run but is sent back by Hope.
Floats it on off, Chase gets his front foot to the pitch of the ball and drives it down to long on for a run.
Shorter in length on off, spinning back in. Chase flicks it through square leg for a run.
Quicker on the stumps. Chase pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter on off, Chase defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Moeen Ali tosses this one up outside off, wanting Chase to drive it against the spin. The batsman obliges and gets it off the outer half through backward point for a boundary.
Just ahead of a length on off, coming back into the batsman. Hope defends it with ease.
Shorter in length, aimed at the ribs of the batsman. Chase who is a tall man comfortably tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Chase keeps his eyes on the ball and defends it.
Fuller in length this time on off, Hope plants his front foot ahead and pushes it towards cover-point for a run.
Anderson comes steaming in and lands it on a length. Shai defends it solidly.
Good length angling into the batsman. Hope tucks it to short mid on.
James Anderson to bowl from the other end.
Drags his length back on the stumps, Chase defends it off the back foot.

NO BALL! FOUR! What was that? Moeen bowls a chest height full toss. Chase swivels inside the crease and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. The umpire also signals a no ball for height.
Tries to work it with the spin towards the leg side but hits it straight to short leg. The ball hits him as he tries to evade it.
Excellent from Moeen! Bowls it a little slower on off, goes on with the arm. Chase tries to drive it straight but gets beaten.
Quicker on off, Chase goes on the back foot and defends it.
Fuller on off, Chase drives it back to the bowler.
Starts off with a flatter delivery on off, Chase lunges forward and defends it.

We are ready to get underway for the final session. The umpires and players are out in the middle. Roston Chase and Shai Hope will resume their innings. Moeen Ali will bowl the first over after the break.
...Day 5, Session 3...

A wicket right at the end of the session has helped England get back into the game. The Windies were cruising when Kraigg Brathwaite and Shai Hope were going along their merry way. They frustrated the English bowlers who looked short of ideas but a lapse in concentration for the former led to his wicket. England will try and run through the middle order post tea and that's their only option if they want to win this Test match. The away side still requires another 123 runs to level the series. Shai Hope is battling it out there but he will need support from the rest. Join us for the final session in a while.
Hurls it in the channel outside off, Shai allows it through to the keeper. That will be tea on the final day!
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Gets a bit forward in defense but it takes the inside edge and rolls in the gap on the leg side. A single taken.
An inswinger around middle, Chase pushes it down to mid on.
Outside off, Chase plays it down from the outer half of the bat to point.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flighted and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Roston Chase is the next man in.

OUT! England get the much-needed breakthrough! Ali delivers a flighted full ball outside off, Brathwaite tries to drive through the line but it takes a thick outside edge which is gobbled sharply by Ben Stokes at first slip. End of a superb knock by Kraigg but he will be disappointed with the way he got out. Also, he missed the chance of getting a twin century at Headingley, a feat never achieved before.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and on off, defended back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
Length ball shaping back into the batsman this time, it's kept out safely on the leg side.
Full and outside off, nipping away, Kraigg pushes it from the outer half of the bat to gully.
Shortish and outside off, shaping away, it's left alone.
Too full in length and wide outside off, Brathwaite reaches out for it and drives it to covers.
Short in length and outside off, punched through covers and Moeen Ali chased it down. A couple taken.
Flighted on off, driven firmly off the front foot to extra cover.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Strides forward and drives it back to the bowler.
Too full in length outside off, Hope tries to dig it out but misses.
Gets on the back foot and blocks it down safely.
Turns it off his pads to mid-wicket.
In the zone outside off, Shai allows it through to the keeper.
Sliding down the leg sid,e the batsman fails to flick and it goes off his thigh pad to square leg for a leg bye.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Outside off, left alone.
Straighter in line, worked on the leg side for a couple at deep square leg.
Good length delivery on off, it's defended from the crease with an angled bat.
Change of ends for James Anderson.
FOUR! Tossed up ball on middle, spinning down, Shai neatly deflects it down to fine leg for a boundary.

Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, Hope tries to defend by taking a stride forward but misses. He is hit on the back pad, they appeal but nothing from the umpire. Impact outside off, confirms the replay.
Loopy off spinner on off, Hope lunges and defends it with his bat and pad together. Drift and spin for Ali!
Leans forward to a full ball and strokes it to mid off.
Pulls his length back a bit and bowls it outside off, Hope goes on the back foot and punches it to mid-wicket.
Floated full ball outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Moeen Ali is into the attack now. Just one over for Anderson.
Targets the off stump with a good length ball, Hope is firmly behind the line in defense.
Bouncer around off, Hope easily ducks underneath it.
Back of a length ball on off, Kraigg goes back and helps it to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but still good enough to take it to the fence. Full and outside off, Brathwaite plays the on drive for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Kraigg gets on his toes and defends it down to covers.
Stokes has some problem with the ball and wants the umpires to have a look at it. They do check but everything is fine for now.
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Kraigg jumps on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Too full in length on off, angling in, Hope drives it to mid off again and this time Broad dives to take the pace off the ball. Deflects it towards long on and they take a couple.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Fullish and on middle, Shai played across the line but straight to mid-wicket.
Bowls it full and outside off, Hope is not tempted by the prospect of playing the cover drive.
Short in length and outside off, slapped through the line but straight to cover-point.
James Anderson is brought back into the attack. The English side is under pressure here. They are desperately in need of a wicket here. Can their best bowler provide it?
Full and angling in, Kraigg defends it from the crease to the leg side.
A touch short in length on off, defended off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Hope presents a straight bat and blocks it to the leg side.
Jumps on the back foot and turns it behind square leg for a run.
Short but wide outside off this time, Kraigg slaps it through backward point for a couple of runs.

EDGED AND FOUR! Oohhh... That's the shot Ben Stokes wanted him to play with a leg gully and fine leg in place. A short ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite top edges his attempted pull shot over the keeper for a boundary.
Slants in a full ball on off, Hope defends it solidly from the front foot. Good over by Broad, excellently played out by Brathwaite and Hope.
In the channel outside off, shaping away, Hope shoulders arms.
Full and spearing into the batsman this time, Brathwaite does well to keep it out safely towards mid on.
Beaten! Great delivery, landing on a length and shooting away with extra bounce, Kraigg pushes at it and misses. The keeper collects the ball, appeals but nothing from anyone else.
Ben Stokes is seen in conversation with Stuart Broad.
Again it's on the fuller length around off, Kraigg is on the front foot as he pushes it to covers.
Pitches it full and on off, Brathwaite pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Good length ball on off, straightening a bit, Shai defends it from the back foot to cover-point.
A well-directed short ball on middle, Brathwaite jumps again and fends it away down to fine leg for a run.
A rising delivery, around off, Kraigg goes on his toes and keeps it out towards mid off.
Drops it on a length and serves it outside off, holding its line, Kraigg allows it through to the keeper.
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Brathwaite jumps on the back foot and defends it to the leg side.
Digs in a short ball but the line is down the leg side, an easy leave for the batsman. Waste of energy on the effort ball.
In the zone outside off, left alone by the batsman again.
Good length delivery in the corridor outside off, angling in, Hope leaves it alone. It carries at a good height to the keeper.
Full and outside off, Hope leans well forward and defends it to the off side.
Crowd trying to get behind Broad and England as he runs in to bowl. Delivers a full ball on off, which is blocked with ease.
Outside off, left alone by Shai.
A length delivery just outside off, angling in, Hope covers the line and lets it through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length and outside off, it's tapped down wide of the diving point fielder for a single.
Shai Hope has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Brathwaite opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball angling down the leg side, Shai goes on his toes to glance but misses and it goes off his thigh pad towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Takes a full length ball from around off and helps it through square leg for a single.
Well bowled and very well played. Some extra bounce from a length outside off, Hope is surprised by it but does well to keep it out with a soft bottom hand.
Full in length and outside off, Hope lunges forward and defends it to the off side.
Bowls it in the channel outside off, Hope allows it through to the keeper.
Angling into the batsman, Hope covers the line and defends.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Tucks it off his pads to deep square leg for a run.
The umpire has given Stuart Broad a warning for kicking the pitch. If any English player does it again West Indies will be awarded five penalty runs.

FOUR! Nicely played! A length ball outside off, Hope sticks back and runs it down past the gully fielder for a boundary. West Indies now need less than what they have already got. Stokes is angry with himself. Shoots some words out of his mouth, hopefully they won't hand him a few more demerit points.
Play and a miss! Lapse in concentration for Shai Hope. Stokes bowls it on a driving length outside off, Hope tries to put it away through covers but misses.
Shortish on middle, Brathwaite controls the extra bounce well and helps it through square leg for one.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Slanting back into the batsman from a length around off, Shai fails to work it around and it goes off his pads to mid-wicket.
Good length ball angling on the pads of the batsman, it's eased through backward square leg for a couple.
A long-awaited change. Ben Stokes is into the attack.

Drinks break. West Indies continue to fight. The current partnership has settled in and is looking in mood to repeat their first innings heroics. England are lacking intent in the field at the moment and seems to be waiting for things to happen, rather than making it happen. 167 runs needed more, 8 wickets in hand with 50 overs left - getting close, folks.
Pitches it full and outside off, it's driven through the line but straight to mid off.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. Broad kicks the turf in frustration. Needs to be careful, might get a few demerit points for it.
100-run stand between Shai Hope and Kraigg Brathwaite again.
FOUR! These two continue to trouble the English team. Broad slips a length ball down the leg side and Brathwaite tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Beaten! Good delivery, bowled with a scrambled seam. It held its line outside off and Brathwaite was caught pushing and missing inside the line.
Good length ball on off, Brathwaite covers the line and blocks it back safely.

FOUR! That was poor from Jimmy Anderson. That could have easily been a chance to run Brathwaite out. Fuller in length on middle, Brathwaite drives it towards Anderson at mid on and sets off for a run. James comes running in towards the ball and goes for the one-handed pick up. He fails to do so and the ball goes between his legs and races to the long on fence. He took the gamble of going with one hand but it did not pay off. Kraigg wanted a risky single but ends up getting a boundary.
FOUR! Another long hop, another pull shot. Not from the middle of the bat but it still races through to the fine leg fence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Poor ball and it gets the desired punishment. Short in length on middle, Hope goes deep inside the crease and pulls it past short leg and in front of square leg for a boundary.
Flatter one on middle, hit across the line through mid-wicket for a single.
In the air... Flighted off spinner on middle, Kraigg flicks it off his pads and it goes a bit uppishly but wide of leg gully for a run.
Spinning down the leg side, Brathwaite allows it through.
A watchful leave outside off stump by Shai Hope.
Beaten all ends up! Top class bowling. Broad hurls in a length ball just outside off, Hope pushes at it but it holds its line to beat the outside edge.
Lands it on a full length outside off, curving away, Shai allows it through to the keeper.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
2nd Test fifty for Shai Hope.

FOUR! Lovely shot to reach your half century! A length ball around middle and leg, Shai turns it off his pads and it races through mid-wicket for a glorious boundary. He is playing a gem and once again putting on a show along with Brathwaite.
Full and angling into the batsman, Shai Hope pushes it down with good timing to mid on.
Switches to around the wicket and bowls a flighted full ball outside off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
A little short in length on middle, Hope goes back and hits it through mid-wicket for one.
Flat and on off, defended back from the crease.
Tossed up ball outside off, Hope gets behind the line, covers the spin and then blocks.
Turning back in, nudged behind square leg for a couple of runs.
Flighted and full outside off, Shai lunges and plays for the spin which ain't there. He misses and Bairstow is quick to dislodge the bails. Nothing doing as Shai was well inside the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Lands it on a length around off and gets it to curve back into the batsman, Kraigg gets an inside edge onto the pads as he attempts to defend. Lucky to get some bat, otherwise he would have been plumb in front. Broad lets out a stifled appeal for an lbw but it dies down quickly.
Fuller length ball on middle, pushed down the ground but straight towards mid on.
Brilliant delivery and well played in the end. Extra bit of bounce from a length around off, Shai takes his bottom hand off the handle and works it behind square leg. A run taken.
Angles in a full ball on off, Hope gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Bowls it on a length outside off, it's left alone by Shai Hope.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it watchfully. All gone too quiet in the field from England. They need to show more intensity.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it on the off side.
Too full and on off, Brathwaite decides to go back and defend.
Loopy and on off again, once more Kraigg pushes it from the outer half of the bat to point.
Flighted outside off, defended off the outer half of the bat to point.
Moeen Ali is back and ready to bowl.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Moeen Ali is sitting near the boundary line waiting for the over to end so that he can return on the field.
Back of a length ball on off, Hope nicely goes on the back foot and punches it through the line. Finds the cover fielder.
In the channel outside off, Hope has nothing to do with it.
Gets this one to shape back into the batsman from a length outside off, Shai does well to defend it from the crease.
Too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Hope leaves it alone.
Moeen Ali is seen walking of the field and also there is a change in the bowling. Stuart Broad comes into the attack. He is the only one to take a wicket, can he provide another breakthrough here.

Poor, poor delivery. A long hop on middle, Hope goes deep inside the crease with the pull shot and connects nicely. However, the placement is not where he intended.It goes straight to the deep square leg fielder and he takes a single. Lets out a cry of anguish for getting the placement wrong.
Flatter and outside off, spinning in and staying low, Shai gets across the stumps and does well to keep it out on the leg side.
Flighted and on off, flicked with the spin on the leg side but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
A bit short and on off, tapped down to point for one.
Too full in length on off, hit back to the bowler on one bounce.
Loopy full ball outside off, Kraigg pushes it off his front foot to covers.
A touch fuller this time but the line is just outside off. Hope does not fiddle with it.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hope opts not to play at it.
Fuller in length this time, Hope times it past mid on for a brace. Woakes is leaking runs here.

Nasty! Shorter in length on off, gets big on the batsman as it spits off the surface. Hope does extremely well to keep it down as he defends it off the back foot. He also takes one hand off the handle as he plays that. Good cricket all around.
Better from Woakes! Length ball in the channel outside off, Hope lets it be.
FOUR! Errs in line! Woakes is not getting it right here. Angles it into the pads. Hope flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Flatter on off, stays a touch low. KB defends it off the back foot off the toe-end.
Slider on off, Brathwaite tries to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes safely towards point.
Fuller outside off, Kraigg drives it towards the man at covers who makes a good stop.
Floats it up around off, turning back in. Brathwaite prods forward and blocks it.
Flatter on off, Brathwaite lunges forward in defense.
Tosses it up on off, Hope plays it with the spin towards long on for a run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
This one nips back into the batsman from around off, nipping in, Brathwaite tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Brathwaite has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! That's a good shot! A leg stump half volley, Brathwaite gets forward and across before flicking it stylishly through square leg for a boundary.
Serves a good length delivery on off, Brathwaite goes back and pushes it to mid off.
Spinning back into the batsman and staying low, Brathwaite does well to keep it out in the gap on the leg side for one.
Around off, driven to mid off.
Slow loopy full ball on off, defended off the front foot.

Flighted and full on middle, driven straight back towards Anderson at silly mid on who dived to his left to make the stop. Did so only partially and it went onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Shai Hope didn't repeat the mistake of his brother and had his bat planted inside the crease.
Slower through the air and it's on the shorter side outside off, the batsman tries to play the square cut but misses.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it towards covers.
Moeen Ali is now into the attack.
Uses his wrists nicely to turns a length ball from around off to mid-wicket. It goes in the gap and they take a run.
Shortish in length and around off, Brathwaite goes on the back foot and plays it down with soft hands to covers.
Shortish ball on off, it's helped down to fine leg for a run.
A length ball on off, keeping a fraction low, Hope defends by crouching low in his crease.

FOUR! Wow, a confident shot off the front foot by Shai Hope. Full in length and on off, Hope gets on the front foot and creams his drive past the diving cover fielder for a boundary. He appears to be a free flowing batsman but at the same time doesn't carry away with shot making. Good prospect for the Windies.
Woakes spears in a fuller length ball on middle, too straight in line and it's easily worked through square leg for a couple of runs.
Lands it full and outside off, Brathwaite defends it back to end the over.
Good length ball on off, staying a touch low, Hope does well to keep his eyes on the ball and keeps it out towards cover-point for one.
Third man is in place now.

FOUR! Edgy this time. Full and on off, Hope is on the front foot in defense but it nips away a bit to take the outside half of the bat. He does well there to play it with soft hands. The ball runs wide of Stokes at gully for a boundary.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, it's not quite there to hit and Shai calmly lets it be.

FOUR! Fine shot! If it's there to be hit, he will hit. Not going into a shell is important. Positive in defense and positive in attack. Really good tempo to their innings. Short in length and outside off, Shai slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary. 100 up for West Indies!
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Shai Hope allows it through to the keeper.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Hurls it in the area outside off, holding its line, a good leave by Kraigg.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman from around off, Brathwaite sticks back in defense.
Full and around off, Kraigg gets on the front foot in defense.
Woakes once again bangs in a short ball and this time Shai pulls it across the line. He has placed it to deep mid-wicket and another three runs have been added to the total.
13th Test fifty for Kraigg Brathwaite.

Fifty for Brathwaite! A good knock by him, so far. He has had his fair share of luck but the key is that he is still going strong for the Windies. Woakes delivers a short ball which is pulled through square leg. It slows down before the rope and is retrieved by the fielder. Three taken. Kraigg raises his bat towards his dressing room and acknowledges the applause.
Length outside off, Hope lets it be.
Shorter in length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
A silly mid on in place for Hope now.
FOUR! No swing this time! Anderson bowls it on middle, Hope flicks it through mid-wicket with great balance and the ball races to the fence.
JAFFA! WOW! Anderson angles it in into the batsman on a fuller length on off, swings away after pitching. Hope tries to flick it on the leg side but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Shai pushes it towards point.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it solidly.
James Anderson will bowl from the other end.
Shorter in length on off, Brathwaite hops and defends it. just one from the over.
Well bowled! Length ball outside off, straightens a touch and also keeps low. Kraigg tries to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten.
Lands it on a length around off, Hope taps it in front of covers for a run.
Angles it on the pads, Hope clips it to mid-wicket.
Length around off, comes back in a touch. Hope tucks it to mid-wicket.
Starts off with a good length delivery on off stump. Hope who has looked solid in defense, prods forward and blocks it.
The men who matter are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Kraigg Brathwaite will continue their innings. Chris Woakes will continue his spell. Here we go...
...Day 5, Session 2...

West Indies are fighting hard! They lost a couple of wickets but added 81 runs at the same time. Kraigg Brathwaite is going strong and should be thanking his luck that he was dropped twice in the session. Stuart Broad was the pick of the bowlers but his other bowling partners are yet to hit their straps. They will be hopeful of running through the Windies' middle order after the break. Let's see how much resistance the visitors can provide. Getting 236 runs in two sessions is not impossible but it's looking unlikely. Do join us in a short while for more action.
Bowls it on off, Brathwaite prods forward and blocks it. LUNCH ON DAY 5!
Quicker on off, KB lunges forward in defense.
Floats it in the air and lands it full on off, Brathwaite drives it to short mid on.
Plays it with the spin towards square leg for a run.
Flatter on off, turning back in. Hope camps back and defends it.
Tosses it up outside off, Hope defends it off the front foot.
Good length outside off, shapes away after pitching. Brathwaite first thinks of playing at it but then pulls his bat out of the way.
Bowls it full on the pads, Brathwaite flicks it to mid-wicket.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Brathwaite ducks under it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Angles it on the stumps from wide of the crease. Brathwaite flicks it to mid on.
Woakes lands it on a length on off, KB defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Works it to mid-wicket with the turn.
Plays it against the spin towards covers for a run.
Darts it down the leg side. Brathwaite misses the flick.

NOT OUT! Fires it on leg stump, turning even further. Brathwaite misses the flick and Bairstow is quick to whip the bails off and appeal. The square leg umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays show Kraigg did lose his balance as he tried to flick but his foot was grounded inside the crease. Not out flashes on the big screen but it was a good piece of glovework from Bairstow.
They have gone upstairs for a stumping appeal. The batsman looks to be fine but the umpire is not taking any chance.
Flights it up on off, Brathwaite drives it back to the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Shorter in length around off, Hope punches it through the covers for a boundary.
Drifts it down the leg side. Hope misses the flick and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Good length on off, Hope defends it off the front foot.
Angles it on the pads, Hope plays it towards mid on.
HUGE APPEAL! Woakes bowls a very full ball on leg stump, Hope misses the flick to get rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
Flatter on off, turning back into the batsman. Brathwaite prods forward in defense but misses and the ball strikes him high on the pads.
The batsman gets up on his toes to play that one with the spin to square leg. One run added to the total.
Fires it on off, goes on with the arm. Brathwaite tries to defend but gets an outside edge towards point for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Tosses it up on off, Brathwaite plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for a boundary. He is playing Moeen really well here. Just working him around with the turn and taking no unnecessary risks.
Driven with the spin towards mid on for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fails to work it across the line and it goes off his pads to the leg side. A couple of leg byes taken.
Angles it into the pads, Hope tucks it through the leg side for a run.
Back of a length around off, Hope guides it to point.
Sprays it down the leg side, Hope misses the flick.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Chris Woakes is now into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Quicker outside off, turning back in. KB tries to flick but misses and is struck on the pads. The English players appeal but the umpire stays put. Just a little high I guess.
Works it with the spin to short leg.
Flighted outside off, turning back in. Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tosses it up outside off, Hope gets his front foot to the pitch of the ball and drives it through extra cover. Root at mid off gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
Lands it on a length, jagging into the batsman. Brathwaite gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to defend.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite goes back and across and pushes it through extra cover and takes a brace.
Good length outside off, Kraigg shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Fuller in length on middle, Brathwaite times this on drive to perfection through mid on for a boundary.
An absolute peach! Length ball around off, outward movement for the bowler. Brathwaite is squared up in defense and gets beaten. That did just enough to miss the outside edge.
Fuller in length outside off, Brathwaite drives it to Woakes at mid off.
Floats it outside off, Shai defends it off the front foot.

Was there an edge? Moeen bowls a slider outside off, Hope plays for the turn but the ball goes off something to Bairstow who fails to collect it. Replays show that was very close to the edge of the bat and had hit the back pad of Hope.
Driven towards the mid-on region.
Flatter outside off, turning back in. Hope shuffles across and misses the flick as he gets hit on the thigh pad. He does well to get outside the line of off stump.
Quicker on the stumps, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Full toss on off, Hope drives it straight to mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length on off, Kraigg guides it to gully.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! And again! Good length outside off, Brathwaite pokes at it and gets an outside edge to the third man fence.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Brathwaite tries to defend but gets an outside edge through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Shai Hope strides out to the middle.

OUT! DROPPED BUT A RUN OUT! A very, very unfortunate way to get out. Broad bowls a fuller ball on the stumps, Brathwaite drives it uppishly back to the bowler who spills the catch but to England's good luck it gets deflected onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Hope was slow to get back into his crease and is adjudged run out. This is not what the Windies wanted. You should be feeling a little sorry for Hope, he was struggling for runs and now he is run out in a very unfortunate manner. Although one can say that he has only himself to blame. There was no need to back up so much. West Indies are two down now and in trouble.
Fires it on the stumps. Hope keeps it out.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flatter on off, stays a touch low. Hope does well to get his bat down and defend it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
BEATEN! Gives it air outside off, goes on with the arm. Hope plays for the spin but gets beaten.
Tosses it up outside off, turning back into the batsman. Brathwaite tucks it down to fine leg for a run.
Moeen Ali is into the attack now. He bowled a testing last over yesterday. Interesting to see if he gets some purchase out of the wicket.
Length ball on off, Kraigg pats it down to extra cover and steals a single.
Another back foot defense offered by Brathwaite.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Angling into the batsman around off, it's defended back to the bowler.
Straighter delivery, knocked through the gap at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Time for Drinks.
Shorter in length outside off, Brathwaite camps back and punches it through covers. Stoneman the fielder gives it a chase and does well to slide and push it back in play. He saves a run for his team.
Good length outside off, KB shoulders his arms to it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! Lands it on a length around off, shapes away after pitching. Brathwaite pokes at it and gets an outside edge towards Westley at third slip who takes it and appeals. The umpires go upstairs and the soft signal is not out. Replays show that the ball bounced just short of the fielder. Kraigg survives a scare.
Tom Westley is claiming a catch here and the umpires have gone upstairs to check. The English players don't seem to be that confident. The soft signal is not out.
Length ball on off, Brathwaite defends it off the front foot.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Kyle Hope is the next man in.

OUT! Broad draws first blood! Powell is the man who has to depart. A very good delivery to get. Broad goes wide of the crease and bowls a fuller length ball on middle from around the wicket. He gets it to nip away off the deck a shade. Powell tries to drive but gets an outside edge to Stokes at fourth slip who pouches it safely. West Indies have lost their first one and they require another 276 runs.
Length outside off, Powell shoulders his arms to it.
Lands it on a length outside off, KB taps it in front of covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Nicely timed! Broad bowls it a touch fuller outside off, Brathwaite pushes it through mid off. Woakes stationed there gives it chase and keeps it down to two.
A touch fuller in length swinging away outside off, Powell points his bat skyward.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

FOUR! Streaky but Powell won't mind. Anderson comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length on off, gets it to straighten a touch. Powell tries to defend but it takes the outside edge through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Anderson is struggling a bit here bowling to the left-hander! Again bowls it on the pads, Powell flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Short of  a length on middle, Powell defends it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length aimed at the ribs of the batsman who tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Comes over the wicket to the right-hander and angles it into the pads. Brathwaite flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Just ahead of a length on off, Powell pushes it towards covers for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, KP leaves it.
FOUR! That was nicely played! Fullish ball outside off, Powell drives it through covers and the ball races to the fence. He is growing in confidence here.
BEATEN AGAIN! Fuller in length around off, shaping away. Powell hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
Full ball outside off, inviting the batsman to drive at it but Powell lets it be.
Back of a length on off, Kraigg defends it solidly.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Fullish ball on off, Kraigg drives it to mid on.

Fuller in length around off, straightens a touch. Brathwaite tries to defend it but misses and the ball hits the pads. The English players appeal but the umpire stays put. The impact might be outside off.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! Just wide of Stokes at fifth slip! Brathwaite is riding his luck here. Back of a length on off, Brathwaite tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge. The ball flies past Stokes who dives full length to his right but fails to reach it. The ball goes down to third man for a boundary.
On a length outside off, Powell pushes inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Powell. Broad comes around the wicket and fires in a full delivery on middle. KP drives it through mid on and the ball races to the boundary.
Just ahead of a length on off, Brathwaite pushes it towards mid off for a run.
A touch fuller outside off, KB eases it to covers.
FOUR! Brathwaite continues from where he left off in the first innings. Fuller on off, Kraigg plants his front foot forward and drives it through mid off for a boundary.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Lands it on a length outside off, Powell is in no mood to play at it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller in length outside off, the batsman does not fiddle with it.
Similar length outside off, Powell opts not to play at it.
Good length outside off, KP lets it be.
FOUR! Errs in line and bowls it on the pads. Powell flicks it down to the fine leg fence.

DROPPED! Cook drops an easy one. You don't see that often, he is as safe as houses. Broad comes steaming in and bowls it on a length around off. Brathwaite pokes at it and gets an outside edge to Cook at first slip who spills it. To add salt to the wound, the ball races down to the fine leg fence. Broad is not happy. Brathwaite gets a reprieve.
BEAUTY! Broad fires it on a length on off, straightens a touch. Brathwaite tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Angles it into the batsman from wide of the crease. Brathwaite flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Kraigg drives it straight to the man at covers.
It has turned quite gloomy. The floodlights have been turned on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length outside off, Brathwaite shoulders his arms to it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Anderson has not got his lines right here! Bowls a length ball, pitched on leg stump. Powell fails to tuck it around the corner and the ball hits him on the pads.
Fuller in length on middle. Powell drives it towards mid on where Broad makes a tumbling stop.
Bowls it down the leg side. Powell tries to flick but misses.
Lands it on a length in line of the stumps. Powell defends it solidly.
Sprays it down the leg side, Powell tries to flick but misses.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Lands it on a length around off, straightens a touch. Kraigg pokes at it and gets beaten.
Bowls an inswinger on the stumps. Brathwaite tries to defend but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
BEATEN! Length on off, Powell tries to defend but is beaten by the away movement.
Guides the ball outside off towards point for a run.
EDGY FOUR! Broad gets some away movement there. Powell tries to flick but gets a leading edge down to the third man fence for a boundary.

The batsman fails to put bat on ball.

The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Anderson comes running in and starts off with a length delivery outside off. Powell plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.

So, after the delay we are now ready to get underway. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Kraigg Brathwaite and Kieran Powell will resume their innings. James Anderson will bowl the first over of the day. He has four slips in place.

The away side will have to play out of their skins and hope to replicate their batting effort of the first innings to salvage a draw or a win. England on the other hand, will be confident heading to take a 2-0 lead. We're in for an enthralling day of cricket. Stay tuned for the action.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the fifth day between England and West Indies at Headingley, Leeds. It was raining a while ago and the covers were on but no need to worry. It has cleared and we will only have a 15 minute delay. 90 overs, 317 runs more and 10 wickets. We head into today with all three results possible. Although a West Indies win looks unlikely but as we know cricket is a game of glorious uncertainties and as this match has panned out we might be in for another surprise.
...Day 5, Session 1...

West Indies survive the nervy period but there were a lot of close shaves in that. James Anderson and Stuart Broad did not start really well but bowled some excellent deliveries in between. Moeen Ali came on for the last over and got a lot of assistance from the wicket. These are not good signs for the Windies batsman. They still need another 317 runs and England have a total of 90 overs to bowl them out. We can expect a thrilling day of cricket tomorrow. Do join us at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, take care and cheers!

What drama to end the day! Quicker one on off, goes on with the arm. Brathwaite plays for the spin but there ain't any and is struck on the back pad. The English players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The hosts have a long chat but decide not to review it. The impact was just outside off, confirms the replay. A good decision in the end. STUMPS ON DAY 4!
Plays it with the spin to short fine leg.
ALMOST! Anderson is placed there at leg slip just for this shot. Fires it on off, turns back in. Brathwaite clips it and the ball falls just short of the leg slip fielder.
Drags his length back outside off, Powell pushes it through covers for a run.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.

TURN IMMEDIATELY! Flatter delivery, pitching outside leg and turning away. Powell tries to defend but is beaten by the away turn and is struck high on the pads. The English players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Moeen Ali is into the attack to bowl the last over of the day.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Good length outside off. Brathwaite is caught in two minds whether to leave it or play at it. He tries to leave it in the end and it goes off the toe end on the bounce to third slip.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Anderson is in the hope that Brathwaite will fall over as he tries the flick but he plays it safely to square leg.
Bowls it on a length on off, Brathwaite defends it off the back foot.

HUGE APPEAL! A length ball pitched on off, jags back into the batsman. Brathwaite is beaten by the movement and is hit flush on the pads. The players go up but nothing from the umpire. A little too high but was very close.
Good length around off, Brathwaite watchfully leaves it.
Lands it on a length outside off, Powell does not play at it.
Change of angle but no change in the direction of the ball. Fires it down the leg side. Powell misses the flick and it goes through to the keeper.
Back of a length on middle, Powell goes back and across to defend it.
Comes from over the wicket. Angles it across the batsman. Powell does not fiddle with it.
Bowls it down the leg side. Powell lets it through to the keeper. The umpire has a word with Broad as he is getting close to the danger area.
Errs in line and sprays it down the leg side. Powell misses the flick.

Goes wide of the crease and bowls an inswinger on off. Brathwaite goes on the back foot to defend but misses and gets struck on the pads. The English players go up in an appeal but nothing from the umpire. Going over the stumps that. A great end to the over by Jimmy.
BEAUTY! James Anderson delivers an absolute peach. Good length landing on off and straightening. Brathwaite tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Good length on off, stays a touch low. Brathwaite does well to get his bat down and defend it.
Better! Closer to the off stump, moving away. Kraigg keeps his eyes on the ball and leaves it.
A little too wide outside off, Brathwaite is in no mood to go after it.
A touch fuller outside off, shaping away. Brathwaite opts not to play at it.
Back of a length on off, Powell defends it solidly.
Wide outside off, Powell need not play at it. Broad is bowling a touch too wide here.
Similar length outside off, Powell leaves it.
Length outside off, wanting Powell to edge it but he lets it be.
Good length around off, some away movement for the bowler. Powell watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Broad comes steaming in and angles it into the pads. The batsman flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Stuart Broad will bowl from the other end.
Lands it on a length outside off. The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length on off, Powell camps back and defends it.
The inswinger this time. Pitches on middle and comes back in. Powell misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire. Doing too much for me.
BEATEN! This time he bowls a similar length but closer to the off stump. Powell has to play at it but is beaten by the away movement.
Lands it on a length, angling across the batsman. Powell plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.

The Windies are underway. Shorter in length outside off, Brathwaite cuts it through the cover-point region. The fielder from point gives it a chase and manages to pull it back before it touches the rope. Three runs taken by the batsmen. Good start for them, chasing a mammoth total.
